zh.summary: 更可靠的桌面运行、迁移与插件体验，并为多个独立 Portable 环境提供完整隔离。
highlights: Windows、macOS 与 Linux 的桌面壳现在使用一致的原生能力边界；文件选择、数据迁移、设置与重启反馈在失败后也能恢复到可继续使用的窗口。
插件安装、更新与卸载会明确显示刷新或重启结果，不再让用户猜测改动是否已经生效。
同一台电脑可以同时运行位于不同目录的 Portable 环境；端口、进程和数据目录彼此隔离，关闭其中一个不会影响另一个。
全新环境离线提供当前的 DSH Chat Manager 1.2.0 与 DSH Image Viewer 0.1.0-beta.3；已有环境保留用户自己的插件状态。
启动、更新和数据导入的生命周期检查进一步收紧，异常退出不会把不完整状态当成成功。

en.summary: More reliable desktop, migration, and plugin flows, with complete isolation between independent Portable environments.
highlights: Windows, macOS, and Linux now share the same bounded native-host capabilities. File selection, data migration, settings, and restart feedback recover to a usable window after a failed operation.
Plugin install, update, and removal now report whether a refresh or restart is needed, so activation is no longer ambiguous.
Independent Portable folders can run side by side on the same computer. Ports, processes, and data roots remain isolated, and stopping one does not interrupt another.
Fresh environments include DSH Chat Manager 1.2.0 and DSH Image Viewer 0.1.0-beta.3 offline, while existing environments keep their user-managed plugin state.
Startup, update, and data-import lifecycle checks are stricter, and incomplete shutdown or recovery is never reported as success.
